notes: Muyuan Foods (SZSE: 002714) — world's largest pork producer by volume (~71M head sold in FY24). Highly vertically integrated: own breeding, feed mills, slaughter, and increasingly downstream meat processing. Reports CNY-millions PRC GAAP. Lists in CNY on Shenzhen Stock Exchange. FY ends Dec 31. Earnings driven by China hog cycle — extreme volatility. Net debt company-defined (interest-bearing only); leases not always disclosed at consolidated level.

periods.notes: FY20: Peak-cycle year — post-ASF China hog prices ~RMB35/kg. Revenue RMB56.3bn, EBITDA RMB33.5bn (margin 60%), NI RMB27.5bn. Massive capacity expansion.
FY21: Hog prices crashed ~50% (post-ASF herd rebuild) — margins collapsed. Revenue RMB78.9bn (+40% on volume), EBITDA RMB16.8bn (margin 21%), NI RMB6.9bn (-75% YoY).
FY22: Hog price recovery 2H22 (RMB22-28/kg). Revenue RMB124.8bn (+58%), EBITDA RMB27.1bn (margin 21.7%), NI RMB13.3bn. 61.2M head sold.
FY23: Trough cycle — hog prices avg RMB14-15/kg (below cost). Revenue RMB110.9bn (-11%), EBITDA RMB13.5bn (margin 12.2%), NI -RMB4.26bn (first annual loss). 63.8M head sold.

FY24: Strong recovery — hog prices avg RMB17/kg, full-year cost down to ~RMB13.7/kg. Revenue RMB137.9bn (+24%), EBITDA RMB31.2bn (margin 22.6%), NI RMB17.8bn. 71.6M head sold (record). Leverage <1.6x.
